notes.title: Update for Hypnospace Outlaw: Saves & Surprises Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/3cf2f7af669734e0de22962445b263aab0dbf8f3.png

Hi everyone!

We're here to drop you a new update for Hypnospace Outlaw - the saves & surprises update! 

We've also got some Slayers X news coming soon - so be sure to keep an eye out when that drops!

To celebrate, we've got a Steam Daily Deal going for Hypnospace right now, which means you can grab the game for 75% OFF!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/e773ba21e2fa6964859be403cb09fa883b11781b.gif

We've made some changes to Steam Cloud Saves, alongside some cool new stuff in-game too! Here's what you can expect to find:

 Updated the game engine to its most recent version
 Save location migrated for Steam Autocloud cloud-save support, and GlobalSettings save file is no longer synced
 Mod.io API update (they changed their API URL)
 The application window's close button is now captured by HypnOS, so when you click the [x] to close, it will prompt you to log off first
 Two additional people added to credits, we're sorry this took so long!
 New default controller layout for a better experience on Steam Deck

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32660404/2bb8f8f2629f9974acf23c11e5151e48ed3692d0.gif

Here are the in-game changes, spoiler warning if you want these to be a surprise:

 [spoiler] Some changes to QueenOfSanderverse poetry, what shouldn't have been there is now GONE [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] A popular, much loved Hypnospace user can now safely be flagged on any/all days, which could change the outcome of certain things... [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] Hypii is now way more dynamic at the start of the HAP chapter - he might just pick up on the present! [/spoiler]
 [spoiler] HAP page-captured spin animation in the Explorer no longer gets "stuck" [/spoiler]


Thank you all again for keeping the Hypnospace universe in check - it's thanks to you enforcers, that Hypnospace is a safe space free of copyright infringement, harassment, and violations! We'll see you next time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844590/Hypnospace_Outlaw/

notes.title: kickass news comin' soon!
notes.content:
hey there, all you hardcore gamers & X slayers

Zane here, the badass behind Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer! yeah, I know its a big name... but trust me the game's gonna blow your freakin' minds! 🤘 check out some new footage form the game itself...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42218571/10591094063deb94a9aa771e6ea16a875cfb6291.gif

let me start by sayin, can't believe i'm writing this post on here. my publisher Mike mentioned "steam" and i was not sure it existed bwl what does he know... ive come a long way since I started making this game as a teenager back in the 90s.. it use to be just a mod but now its a full on game.... thanks Adam Chase for full filling your promise to help finish coding it. 

 it's been a wild ride, but now I'm all grown up, and i've poured my heart and soul & lotto money (I won a scratch off) into creating this as the most brutal, gory, and messed up shooter game.

slayers X is gonna be the ultimate for all you guys and girls. working at Dollarshaver sucks & if u wish u could awaken the green energy inside & show your idiot boss whos the real boss, you will like this game. get ready to let out all your pent up rage & anger against the psykos as you step into the blood-soaked boots of the Slayer and join on our quests! 

armed with arsenal of many kickass weapons and fueled by pure vengance agsinst the psyko SINdikate, you'll embark on a journey through twisted dimensions and face off against hordes of grotesque creatures that'll haunt your nightmares. 

i got a cool present for you all - soundtrack of battle anthems me and Mikey prepared with other slayers - come and enjoy! and another here: playlist2.

now, i know some of you might be thinkin', "zane, what makes slayers X so freakin' special?" well, first off, the graphics are gonna melt your eyeballs! its looks Boise... but twisted in a way where darkness and metal collide - that game all started as a Kataklysm mod! 

its like stepping into a music video from my favorite band, Seepage! Mikey Sykey (lead singer) is there too... because he found out about my comics because some people tried making fun of them. that backfired because now Seepage is in my game officially....

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42218571/002c507eaf41deeefc11cf255703229e78afeaba.gif

the graphics are awesome but the gameplay is even more awesome.... i spend every hour after I put Mikey to bed (my kid) perfecting EVERY brutal enemy encounter.... and every mind-bendingily good level design... and every joke. and if something didnt work, Chase helped a lot... it's all about fast-paced action, intense firefights, and heart-pounding moments that'll make your pulse race like crazy! my heart probably got plapitations from all this. & because i eat a lot of butter... bwl.

wait there's more! were not done. we've got some kickass news comin' your way real soon, its been too quiet here forawhile... i don't want to spill all the potatos yet, but let's just say you better buckle up cause were cooking up some brain blowing stuff for all you Slayers!
your going to poop your pants when u hear about what else is going on bwl bwl

so mark your calendars - the game is gonna drop like a freakin' atom bomb terd into a huge toilet on here..... stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and riffs to get your adrenaline pumpin'...

thanks for stickin' with me,... let's make slayers X the sickest game ever unleashed!

bye
Zane

ps. if you wanna join our secret hideout from psykos, head to our STEEL SEWER. cool things go on there with Mikey bwl
